XMLDB.COMMENT: Airpay Recompletion — annual / periodic course completion reset.

FIELD.NAME: courseid
FIELD.COMMENT: 0 = all courses with completion enabled, else specific course

FIELD.NAME: period_days
FIELD.COMMENT: Reset every N days. 365=annual, 90=quarterly.

FIELD.NAME: trigger_type
FIELD.COMMENT: completion|enrolment|fixed — what the period counts from. Named '_type' to avoid the MariaDB reserved word 'trigger'.

FIELD.NAME: fixed_date
FIELD.COMMENT: Unix ts if trigger=fixed

FIELD.NAME: reset_grades
FIELD.COMMENT: Also reset grades when resetting completion

FIELD.NAME: reset_attempts
FIELD.COMMENT: Also reset quiz attempts

FIELD.NAME: costcenterid
FIELD.COMMENT: Tenant scope; 0 = all tenants

FIELD.NAME: last_run_at
FIELD.COMMENT: Last successful cron pass

FIELD.NAME: last_run_resets
FIELD.COMMENT: Count of users reset on last run

FIELD.NAME: legacy_config
FIELD.COMMENT: BizLMS import (ADR-032): every name/value row of the legacy local_recompletion_config for the course, as one JSON object. NULL for a rule created in Sentientia. The rule cannot express email templates, extra quiz attempts or the archive switches, so they are kept here for the rules page and for the engine parity work.

FIELD.NAME: reset_by_userid
FIELD.COMMENT: Admin who triggered (NULL for cron)

FIELD.NAME: previous_timecompleted
FIELD.COMMENT: When the user last completed before reset

FIELD.NAME: source
FIELD.COMMENT: engine = written by recompletion_engine; legacy = imported from BizLMS local_recompletion (ADR-032)

FIELD.NAME: time_inferred
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 = timecreated was worked out from the archived completion, not read from a log row of the reset itself

TABLE.NAME: local_sentientia_recompletion_archive
TABLE.COMMENT: Archived evidence of the cycle a reset ended

FIELD.NAME: historyid
FIELD.COMMENT: The reset that ended this cycle (local_sentientia_recompletion_history.id); 0 when it cannot be told

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: Whose evidence it is; 0 = an anonymous response or a redacted row

FIELD.NAME: itemtype
FIELD.COMMENT: course_completion|criteria_completion|activity_completion|quiz_attempt|quiz_grade|scorm_track|lti_grade|questionnaire_response|questionnaire_answer|gradebook_grade (gradebook_grade: written by the engine only)

FIELD.NAME: instanceid
FIELD.COMMENT: Quiz, SCORM, LTI tool, questionnaire or completion criteria id, by itemtype

FIELD.NAME: parentid
FIELD.COMMENT: A questionnaire answer points at its response row in this table

FIELD.NAME: itemkey
FIELD.COMMENT: SCORM element or questionnaire question id

FIELD.NAME: grade
FIELD.COMMENT: As archived (a quiz attempt holds raw marks); NULL when out of range or not a number

FIELD.NAME: timeevent
FIELD.COMMENT: When the archived thing happened

FIELD.NAME: payload
FIELD.COMMENT: The archived row, every column, as JSON

FIELD.NAME: timecreated
FIELD.COMMENT: When it was archived: the reset time of its cycle when known, else the time of the event
